As Amazon’s Black Friday Sale continues, there are countless Green Deals worth jumping on – all of which can be found in our Black Friday Green Deals Seasonal Hub that we will continue updating through the rest of the month. There’s plenty of low prices, like on ECOVACS’ three LiDAR Pro Robot Lawn Mowers starting from $949 , the Autel MaxiCharger AC Pro 80A Level 2 EV Charger at $909 that adds 70 miles to an EV’s battery per hour charging, or even GoTrax’s Dyno Drift Electric Go Kart for kids at $240 . We’ve also got Bluetti’s fully expanded Black Friday Sale with exclusive bonus, with options that include the Elite 300 3,014Wh Power Station at $1,044 , and more waiting for you below.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
All three ECOVACS LiDAR Pro robot lawn mowers hit lowest prices for Black Friday starting from $949
As part of Amazon’s major Black Friday event , you can currently find all three of ECOVACS LiDAR Pro Robot Mowers down at their best prices, starting with the Goat O1000 LiDAR Pro Robot Lawn Mower at $949 shipped . Down from $1,500, the discounts that we’ve seen over 2026 started by taking the price down to $1,199, and later dropped further to $999 over the summer. October’s Prime Day event gave us the first fall to this rate, with it coming back for a second time chance at $551 savings to the all-time lowest tracked price. Likewise, there’s also the A2000 LiDAR Pro counterpart at $1,329 shipped , as well as the A3000 LiDAR Pro counterpart at $1,799 shipped .
O1000 LiDAR Pro Robot Lawn Mower: $949 (Reg. $1,500)
A2000 LiDAR Pro Robot Lawn Mower: $1,329 (Reg. $2,000)
A3000 LiDAR Pro Robot Lawn Mower: $1,799 (Reg. $2,500)
Bluetti’s updated Black Friday Sale drops 3,014Wh Elite 300 power station to exclusive $1,044, more from $450
Alongside Amazon’s Black Friday savings event , Bluetti has officially moved to its full Black Friday Sale event , with increased discounts on power stations, as well as our exclusive bonus savings code 9TO5TOYS5OFF to be used at checkout. One notable deal worth considering is the Elite 300 3,014Wh Portable Power Station down at $1,044.05 shipped , after using the above code, which matches the price over at Amazon . Down from a newer $1,199 MSRP, though it goes for as much as $1,599 elsewhere, including at Amazon, it’s often only gone as low as $1,100 this year, though we did see it drop to $1,039 and then $999 back in June. The deal here gives you the next-best price with $155 savings ($555 off the highest Amazon pricing), landing it just $45 above June’s low.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
***NOTE: We haven’t added in any of the exclusive or extra savings into the prices you see below, so make sure you use our code 9TO5TOYS5OFF at checkout for the best deals!
Top picks from Bluetti’s Black Friday lineup:
Elite 100 V2 (1,024Wh) power station: $450 (Reg. $499)
Elite 200 V2 (2,073.6Wh) power station: $899 (No initial price cut)
FridgePower (2,016Wh) with Display1: $999 (No initial price cut)
Elite 300 (3,014Wh) power station: $1,099 (Reg. $1,699)
Apex 200 (2,560Wh) power station: $1,149 (Reg. $1,399)
2x FridgePower (4,032Wh) power stations: $1,600 (Reg. $1,799)
5kWh RV Kit (5.12kWh): $3,699 (Reg. $3,999)
You can browse the entire Bluetti Black Friday Sale lineup of deals here .
Add 70 miles to your EV for every hour charging from this 80A Autel level 2 station now at a $909 low ($390 off)
As part of Amazon’s ongoing Black Friday Sale , you can find Autel’s official storefront offering its MaxiCharger AC Pro 80A Level 2 Residential EV Charger back down at $908.65 shipped . Down from $1,299, we’ve seen this deal pop up every few months in the year, with the price otherwise discounted to $1,069. You’re getting $390 cut from the tag during this savings event, landing it back at the all-time lowest price we have tracked. You can find more of Autel’s EV charger deals in the Amazon storefront here .
GoTrax’s Dyno Drift electric go kart for kids just hit a new $240 low for your Christmas gifting
Within the massive Amazon Black Friday lineup of deals , you can find the GoTrax Dyno Drift Electric Go Kart for Kids down at $239.99 shipped . Down from $299, we’ve previous seen discounts take the cost down to $269 or $254. Now though, with this month’s savings event in full swing, you’re able to grab one for your child aged eight and older with a larger $59 markdown, landing it at a new all-time low – just in time to cross it off your Christmas shopping list.
Segway’s full Black Friday Sale drops Xyber Air smart e-bike to new $1,800 low with first discount, more from $135
Redtiger multi-channel dash cams up to 37% off for Black Friday: 4K front and rear + 128GB card at $110, more from $76
Black Friday 2026 Green Deals Hub: e-bikes, EVs, power stations, tools, appliances, and more
